name: Pacific Packaging Industries
old_description: Pacific Packaging was founded in 1947 with a single customer- a local potato farm. With Pacific Packaging's focus on personal attention, great products at a competitive price and top-notch customer service, the company continued to grow. Today, Pacific Packaging Industries is a global operation with customers around the world.
about:
Pacific Packaging Industries was founded in 1947 in Portland, Oregon, beginning with a single customer—a local potato farm. The company has since grown into a global operation serving customers worldwide.

The company manufactures and distributes custom flexible packaging, specializing in printed woven and non-woven polypropylene bags. Its capabilities include a full-service printing and art department, high-quality proofing services, and the design of custom packaging solutions. Product lines encompass BOPP films, printed woven polypropylene, printed burlap, stock packaging, bulk bags, and earthbag building systems.

Pacific Packaging serves a range of industries, including food packaging, pet food and related products, retail packaging, agricultural feed and seed, and landscaping products. The company emphasizes personal attention to each customer's packaging needs.

The firm differentiates itself through personal attention, a wide variety of innovative packaging materials and features, creative full-service printing and art department, endless package design possibilities, and high-quality proofing services.
